introduction: Fork-authoritative patch branches for carry-patch workspaces: when a workspace opts in with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin, POST /workspaces/:slug/sync fetches the fork, brings every registered patch branch to the fork's tip under a divergence policy, treats a moved patch branch as a rebuild trigger, and reports and persists per-branch outcomes. Workspaces that do not opt in keep their current behaviour.

glossary.action: What sync did to a local patch branch: none, created, fast_forwarded or replaced.
glossary.backup ref: refs/hub/replaced/<branch>, which holds the hub-side tip discarded by a replacement.
glossary.candidate patch: A patch of the workspace whose status is active, conflict or disabled, excluding any patch whose name equals the integration branch.
glossary.carry-patch workspace: A workspace whose integration branch is rebuilt from upstream HEAD plus an ordered list of registered patch branches.
glossary.compare-and-swap ref write: git update-ref <ref> <new> <expected-old>, which fails when the ref no longer holds the expected old SHA; the all-zero SHA is the expected old value for a create.
glossary.divergence: Neither tip is an ancestor of the other, or the fork tip is a strict ancestor of the local tip.
glossary.fork / origin: The remote named origin of the trunk; in origin mode it is the authority for patch branches.
glossary.hub: The af-hub service and its git server; in hub mode its local refs/heads/* are the authority for patch branches.
glossary.patch advanced: A candidate patch branch with status active or conflict that sync moved by created, fast_forwarded or replaced.
glossary.patch branch: A branch registered in the patches table; the rebuild reads it only from refs/heads/<branch> in the trunk.
glossary.state: The relationship between the local patch branch and the fork after the sync: in_sync, diverged or missing_on_origin.

requirements.title: Patch source and divergence policy configuration
requirements.rationale: Operators opt a workspace into fork authority per workspace and must be able to change it without a restart.

criteria.condition: a carry-patch sync has taken the workspace lock
criteria.action: read PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE and PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY through GetVariable("workspace", slug, name) on that sync, before any fetch
criteria.contract: a variable changed between two syncs takes effect on the second sync without a hub restart

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE has exactly the value "origin"
criteria.action: select origin as the authority for patch branches

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is unset, its lookup returns an error, or its value is anything other than the exact case-sensitive string "origin" (including "hub", "Origin" and an empty string)
criteria.action: select hub as the authority and continue the sync
criteria.contract: no error is returned to the caller and the sync follows the hub path

criteria.condition: PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY has exactly the value "report"
criteria.action: apply the report policy to diverged patch branches

criteria.condition: PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY is unset, its lookup returns an error, or its value is anything other than the exact string "report"
criteria.action: apply the replace policy
criteria.contract: no error is returned to the caller

criteria.condition: the selected source is hub
criteria.action: ignore PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY

requirements.title: Origin fetch
requirements.rationale: The fork must be fetched, with stale tracking refs pruned, before patch branches can be compared with it.

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin
criteria.action: fetch the origin remote of the trunk with refspec +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*, no tags and pruning of tracking refs whose branch no longer exists on the fork, using credentials from workspace.ResolveCloneAuth (GIT_PAT, then GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD, then none), and treat an already-up-to-date result as success

run, under the workspace lock the sync already holds, in this order: origin credential resolution, upstream fetch, origin fetch, upstream-base resolution, patch refresh, merge detection, workspace update

criteria.condition: origin credential resolution fails
criteria.action: abort before either fetch and change nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message "failed to resolve origin credentials"; upstream_head_sha, last_sync_at, patch rows and refs are unchanged

criteria.condition: the origin fetch fails after the upstream fetch succeeded
criteria.action: abort the sync leaving upstream_head_sha, last_sync_at, patch statuses, persisted origin sync state and every refs/heads/* ref unchanged, without rolling back upstream tracking refs
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message "origin fetch failed" and error_type "origin_fetch_failed"

criteria.condition: the selected source is hub
criteria.action: perform zero origin fetches and zero origin credential lookups

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin and SyncAPIConfig.FetchOrigin is nil
criteria.action: abort without changing state
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message "origin fetch is not configured"

criteria.condition: a branch has been deleted on the fork and an origin-mode sync fetches it
criteria.action: remove the refs/remotes/origin/<branch> tracking ref so the branch resolves as absent on the fork

requirements.title: Per-branch outcome against the fork tip
requirements.rationale: Each registered patch branch must end a sync at the fork's tip or be reported, under one deterministic rule set.

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin and both fetches have succeeded
criteria.action: evaluate as candidates, in position order, only patches with status active, conflict or disabled, excluding patches with status merged_upstream or deleted and any patch whose name equals the integration branch

criteria.condition: a candidate has no refs/remotes/origin/<branch> ref
criteria.action: leave the local branch unchanged and record state missing_on_origin with action none, leaving the patch status unchanged

criteria.condition: a candidate has a fork tip and no refs/heads/<branch>
criteria.action: create refs/heads/<branch> at the fork tip with action created and state in_sync

criteria.condition: the local tip and the fork tip resolve to the same SHA
criteria.action: write no ref and record state in_sync with action none

criteria.condition: the local tip is a strict ancestor of the fork tip
criteria.action: move the local branch to the fork tip with action fast_forwarded and state in_sync

criteria.condition: a candidate has diverged (neither tip is an ancestor of the other, or the fork tip is a strict ancestor of the local tip)
criteria.action: first write the local tip to refs/hub/replaced/<branch>, overwriting any earlier backup for that branch, then move the local branch to the fork tip, recording action replaced, state in_sync and the replaced SHA
criteria.contract: refs/hub/replaced/<branch> holds the former local tip and refs/heads/<branch> holds the fork tip

criteria.condition: a candidate has diverged
criteria.action: leave the local branch unchanged and record state diverged with action none, reporting both the local and fork SHAs

for any candidate, decide ancestry with GitRunner.IsAncestor on the SHAs resolved at the start of that candidate's step, never on branch names, and apply only the first matching rule in the order: fork branch missing, local branch missing, same commit, local strict ancestor of fork, diverged

requirements.title: Safe ref writes
requirements.rationale: The git server does not take the workspace lock, so a push can land mid-sync and must never be overwritten silently.

criteria.action: write every patch ref and backup ref with git update-ref <ref> <new> <expected-old> through GitRunner.Run, using the SHA resolved at the start of the step as expected-old and the all-zero SHA for a create, and never use checkout, reset or branch -f to move a ref

criteria.condition: a patch branch is moved by created, fast_forwarded or replaced
criteria.guard: symbolic-ref -q HEAD in the trunk equals refs/heads/<branch>
criteria.action: hard-reset the trunk working tree to the new tip with GitRunner.HardReset(ctx, "HEAD")
criteria.contract: the trunk's working-tree files match the new tip

criteria.condition: a ref write fails for a candidate, including a lost compare-and-swap
criteria.action: stop the refresh at that patch, keep and persist the outcomes already produced for earlier patches, still make the auto-rebuild decision for branches already moved, write neither upstream_head_sha nor last_sync_at, and leave later patches unprocessed
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message "failed to update patch branch <branch>"; the next sync sees the unmoved branches as still needing work

criteria.action: count a branch moved by created, fast_forwarded or replaced as patch advanced only when its status is active or conflict, and count a moved disabled patch as refreshed and reported but not advanced

for any sync where the source is hub or the policy is report, write no refs/hub/replaced/* ref and move no refs/heads/* ref of a diverged patch; for any sync where the source is hub, write no patch ref at all

requirements.title: Rebuild trigger and sync completion
requirements.rationale: A fork-side change must rebuild the integration branch exactly like an upstream advance, even when upstream did not move.

criteria.action: evaluate the "upstream HEAD has not changed" early return only after the patch refresh, so a patch-only change reaches merge detection and the rebuild enqueue

criteria.condition: upstream advanced or any patch branch counted as patch advanced
criteria.action: run merge detection over active patches using the refreshed tips; with the hub source, run it exactly when upstream advanced

criteria.condition: upstream advanced, a patch branch counted as patch advanced, or at least one patch was newly marked merged_upstream
criteria.action: enqueue a rebuild job with key slug, group slug:integration_branch and SubmittedBy set to the caller, so patch-triggered and upstream-triggered rebuilds collapse into one job
criteria.contract: rebuild_triggered true and rebuild_job_id set; rebuild_triggered false when the enqueue is deduplicated

criteria.condition: upstream advanced or a patch branch counted as patch advanced
criteria.action: enqueue no rebuild job
write last_sync_at and updated_at on every sync that completes, in hub and origin mode, whether or not anything advanced, and write upstream_head_sha only when upstream advanced

criteria.condition: neither upstream nor any patch changed in a sync
criteria.action: return an empty patches_merged and rebuild_triggered false
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with patches_merged [] and rebuild_triggered false

requirements.title: Sync response and CLI
requirements.rationale: Clients and CI scripts need to see which branches moved and diverged without breaking existing consumers.

criteria.action: include the boolean origin_fetched in every response, true when the fork was fetched in this sync and false otherwise, and in hub mode add no other field to the existing response

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin
criteria.action: include patches_synced with one element {branch_name, action, state, local_sha, origin_sha, replaced_sha} per candidate, omitting local_sha when there is no local branch, origin_sha when the fork has no such branch, and replaced_sha unless the action is replaced, and include patches_diverged listing the branch names whose state is diverged (always [] under replace)

serialise an empty patches_synced or patches_diverged as [] in origin mode, in both the CarryPatchSyncResponse JSON body and the asExtras map merged into the workspace response, and omit both fields in hub mode

criteria.condition: afc workspace sync succeeds
criteria.action: print the response JSON including origin_fetched, patches_synced and patches_diverged and exit 0, including when patches_diverged is not empty and --fail-on-diverged is absent
criteria.contract: exit code 0; existing fields are printed unchanged

criteria.condition: afc workspace sync succeeds with --fail-on-diverged
criteria.action: print the response JSON, then print a message naming the diverged branches

criteria.condition: afc workspace sync runs with --wait and --fail-on-diverged
criteria.action: run the diverged check only after the rebuild wait finishes, and let a wait failure take precedence
criteria.contract: exit 1 on wait failure, otherwise exit 3 when patches_diverged is not empty; exit codes 1 and 2 keep their current meaning

requirements.title: Persisted sync state and dashboard
requirements.rationale: The patch-status dashboard must show when and how each patch last compared with the fork.

criteria.action: add the nullable columns origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at through the idempotent patchFieldDDL mechanism, without backfill, on a database that already has a patches table and across repeated initSchema runs

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin
criteria.action: write for each candidate patch its state, the fork tip SHA (null for missing_on_origin) and an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp from apikit.NowUTC, and clear the three columns of merged_upstream and deleted rows

criteria.condition: the selected source is hub
criteria.action: clear the three columns of every patch row of the workspace on each carry-patch sync
expose writing and clearing of the three columns through additive methods on PatchStore, SQLPatchStore and the test doubles, leaving existing methods unchanged
expose origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at through Patch, scanPatch, patchSelectColumns and patchResponse on every patch response, omitting each when null

criteria.condition: a client requests GET /workspaces/:slug/patch-status
criteria.action: include the three fields per patch (omitted when null) and add patches_diverged and patches_missing_on_origin to the summary, always present and 0 in hub mode

requirements.title: Audit events and logging
requirements.rationale: A replacement discards commits, so it needs an auditable record beyond the response.

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin
criteria.action: emit one hub.patch.sync audit event per sync that completes, with metadata {origin_fetched, created[], fast_forwarded[], replaced[], diverged[], missing_on_origin[]} where each list holds branch names

criteria.condition: a patch branch is replaced
criteria.action: emit one hub.patch.replace audit event with branch_name, replaced_sha and origin_sha, and log the replacement at info level with slug, branch and both SHAs
emit each event with the calling credential as actor, resource_type patch and the workspace slug, using the event type constants added to internal/audit/types.go

criteria.condition: the selected source is hub
criteria.action: emit no hub.patch.sync event

criteria.condition: a ref-write failure ends the refresh
criteria.action: still emit the events for the outcomes already produced

criteria.condition: SyncAPIConfig.Audit is nil
criteria.action: skip event emission and complete the sync

criteria.condition: Audit.Emit returns an error
criteria.action: log the error and continue the sync
criteria.contract: the sync response status and body are the same as when the emit succeeds

requirements.title: Documentation
requirements.rationale: The project steering treats stale documentation as a regression.

criteria.action: document the sync response table and Carry-Patch Sync Flow (origin fetch, patch refresh, the early-return move, last_sync_at on every sync, rebuild on patch change), PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE and PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY in the Workspace Variables Reference, the extended AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC text, the patch response and patch-status fields, the 502 messages "origin fetch failed" and "failed to resolve origin credentials", and the hub.patch.sync and hub.patch.replace events
describe the sync description and 200/502 responses, CarryPatchSyncResponse with the always-present origin_fetched, the patch schema and the patch-status schema
document the --fail-on-diverged flag and exit code 3 of afc workspace sync

document PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE and PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY in Configuration and add one note under the sync section covering the two models and that, until fork_push_control ships, hub pushes to patch branches are replaced by the next origin-mode sync, leaving docs/configuration.md unchanged

execution_paths.title: Fork-side fix fast-forwards a patch and triggers a rebuild with upstream unchanged

steps.action: sets PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin and POST /workspaces/:slug/sync after a patch branch advanced on the fork
takes the workspace lock, reads the variables, resolves origin credentials, fetches upstream then origin with pruning
finds the local tip a strict ancestor of the fork tip and moves refs/heads/<branch> with a compare-and-swap update-ref
persists origin_sync_state in_sync, origin_sha and origin_synced_at, runs merge detection, writes last_sync_at and enqueues a rebuild job
emits hub.patch.sync and returns patches_synced with action fast_forwarded, origin_fetched true and rebuild_triggered true

execution_paths.title: Divergence under the replace policy keeps a backup of the discarded tip

steps.action: POST /workspaces/:slug/sync in origin mode when a hub push left a patch branch diverged from the fork
writes the local tip to refs/hub/replaced/<branch>, then moves refs/heads/<branch> to the fork tip
emits hub.patch.replace with branch_name, replaced_sha and origin_sha and emits hub.patch.sync listing the branch under replaced
enqueues a rebuild and returns patches_synced with action replaced and replaced_sha, and an empty patches_diverged

execution_paths.title: Divergence under the report policy fails a CI sync with exit 3

steps.action: runs afc workspace sync --fail-on-diverged for a workspace with PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY=report
detects divergence, leaves the local branch unchanged, persists origin_sync_state diverged and returns patches_diverged with the branch
prints the response JSON, prints a message naming the diverged branches and exits 3
reads GET /workspaces/:slug/patch-status and sees the patch with origin_sync_state diverged and patches_diverged 1 in the summary

execution_paths.title: Origin fetch failure aborts the sync without changing state

steps.action: POST /workspaces/:slug/sync in origin mode while the fork is unreachable
completes the upstream fetch and then fails the origin fetch
returns 502 "origin fetch failed" with error_type origin_fetch_failed, leaving upstream_head_sha, last_sync_at, patch statuses, persisted sync state and refs/heads/* unchanged

execution_paths.title: Hub-mode sync stays unchanged apart from origin_fetched and last_sync_at

steps.action: POST /workspaces/:slug/sync on a workspace without PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin and with no upstream change
fetches only upstream, performs no origin credential lookup or origin fetch, writes no patch ref, and clears origin sync columns of all patch rows
writes last_sync_at and returns empty patches_merged, rebuild_triggered false and origin_fetched false with no patches_synced field

execution_paths.title: A ref-write failure keeps earlier outcomes and still triggers the rebuild

steps.action: POST /workspaces/:slug/sync in origin mode while a hub push lands on the second candidate branch after its ancestry check
fast-forwards the first candidate and persists its outcome
fails the compare-and-swap update-ref for the second candidate and stops the refresh
enqueues the rebuild for the branch already moved, emits events for the produced outcomes, and writes neither upstream_head_sha nor last_sync_at
returns 500 "failed to update patch branch <branch>"

symbols.name: PlainOpen
symbols.notes: Signature taken from the call site in internal/upstream/upstream.go; source not readable.

symbols.name: FetchOptions
symbols.signature: struct with RemoteName string, RefSpecs []config.RefSpec, Auth transport.AuthMethod, Tags TagMode, Prune bool
symbols.notes: Prune is not used elsewhere in the repo and is unverified; the real-bare-fork integration test must confirm it removes refs/remotes/origin/<branch> for a branch deleted on the fork, otherwise the fetch deletes stale tracking refs itself.
